notes.why: the user, 11-17, on his round-7 run: 「岩宝也是太僵硬」 - his design rested both stone fists on the ground (the near one on the ground row, the far one 3 rows over it), so his body could not sink with his steps: B7's run sank it 2 rows, the fists already 1-2 rows under the soles
notes.fists: the cut across each arm along its own outline (design rows 36-44): the far fist's path runs on the outline all the way, the near one's crosses 7 colour squares (made outline: the raised fist's top edge)
notes.rows: 4 dense squares (3.4 game px at his PPU 1.16; 1x: 3): the near fist 4 rows over the ground, the far 7; his forearms 4 rows shorter
notes.run: the knuckle walk: the near fist up 1 / 2 / 1 more rows while the far leg steps (frames 0-2), the far fist while the near leg steps (4-6)
